title: OSCAR: Orchestrated Service & Citizen AI Router
summary: Peterborough and Datnexa are developing OSCAR to connect council services. The council reports that OSCAR Workforce is live, but has not supplied measured results.
account: Peterborough’s May 13, 2026 LGA case study describes OSCAR as a proof of concept for connecting council assistants through a shared service interface. Datnexa identifies itself as the development partner and describes AI that interprets requests and routes them to specialist services. On October 21, the council reported that OSCAR Workforce was live and helped staff find emails and documents and query data faster. It did not publish timings, user counts, or a comparative evaluation. The resident-facing accessibility benefits remain intended. A separate council contract identifies Datnexa as the supplier for Workforce design and scoping. That contract establishes procurement, not a measured benefit.
purpose: Connect service-specific assistants through a shared, governed digital front door.
system: OSCAR, the Orchestrated Service & Citizen AI Router, and OSCAR Workforce

ratings.reason: The council reports that OSCAR Workforce helps staff find information and query data faster, but supplies no measured comparison or independently evaluated organizational result.
The resident-facing system is intended to simplify access to council services. The retained sources supply no measured resident outcome.

ai_role.statement: OSCAR is intended to interpret requests, route them among specialist agents, and apply common controls. Datnexa states that the system will not independently diagnose, decide eligibility, or make safeguarding judgments. The council reports internal Workforce use, but no source supplies a model version, task-level test results, or an independent assessment of the AI contribution.

produced_by: The framework is designed for web, WhatsApp, and voice channels and for connection to existing services.
The reported design includes centralized permissions, redaction, guardrails, and audit logging.
must_hold: Specialist services and information sources must be available for the routing system to use
Human staff must retain responsibility for the decisions that the system is not authorized to make
Access controls and records of system actions must work in the deployment, rather than merely being described in the design
